name: znetwork_get_player_color_index_by_key
description: zNetwork::GetPlayerColorIndexByKey returns a player's color index only when the player record exists, a session descriptor is cached, and the color index is in the active player range.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent zNetwork player-record/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48b9a0 validates calling zNetwork::FindPlayerRecordByKey, zero return for missing record or missing g_zNetwork_CurrentSessionDescCache, reading colorIndex at player record offset 0xe0, accepting only color indexes >= 1 and <= session maxPlayers at descriptor offset 0x30, and returning zero otherwise.
The native player-record accessor smoke verifies valid color return, missing-key zero return, too-high color rejection, and missing-session zero return.
